_comment_apiKey: NEVER put a key in this file - it is tracked by git. Leave this empty and export LLM_API_KEY (read by src/llm/index.js; OPENAI_API_KEY is the fallback name) in your shell or in an untracked .env. A key committed here is a key published here.
_comment_toolCalling: ON since 2026-10-04 (operator decision). The model may call the eight tools (observe, find_blocks, scan_around, lookup_item, do_task, go_to, do_skill, stop) before deciding, so it looks at the world instead of imagining it: scan_around returns the egocentric terrain grid and every refused/failed call carries failure+hint. Verified live on deepseek-flash: the tool round needs the assistant's reasoning_content replayed and a completion budget big enough for thinking-mode reasoning (both fixed in 513bf33). Requires a provider with native tool calling; the plain intent-JSON exchange remains the fallback when the round is invalid or loops.
_comment_persona: The character (name / species / trigger / maxChars / style) lives in config/persona.md and nowhere else. `file` only tells the loader where that sheet is; the legacy string fields (name/style/honesty/maxChars) still exist in src/util/config.js as a safety net for the case where the sheet fails to load, and are ignored while it loads. Do not re-add them here: a leftover `style` used to append '猫娘...带喵' to a 大肥鱼 character sheet that never mentions cats, and a leftover `maxChars` silently overrode the sheet's own limit.
_comment_usage: M7/A30 per-request ledger: one JSONL record per provider call with requestId/kind/model/status/usage. Missing provider usage is recorded as status=missing-usage and usage=null, never 0. Offline fixtures construct LlmCore without this ledger, so tests do not write it.
